prior_exclusion.reason: The operator creates intersection points and does not split input lines.

catalog_evidence.description: This algorithm creates point features where the lines in the Intersect layer intersect the lines in the Input layer.
catalog_evidence.attribute_contract: May retain selected fields from both input layers.

taxonomy_evidence.target_definition: Computes geometric intersection of input features retaining only overlapping areas with attributes from all inputs.
taxonomy_evidence.rejected_definition: Splits line features at locations where they intersect point features.

decision: Map the point-producing line intersection operation to the existing Intersect capability; do not add a new L3 or broaden Split Line at Point.
